title: PlatformOwnerSettingsChange
description: platform.owner-settings-change@1 (AI Exchange D11): body of PATCH /internal/owner-settings on each service that owns owner settings. It changes one or more typed values at once. A key whose setting has source env is pinned and the service answers 409 settings.pinned_in_env; a secret-type setting is never changed here (use platform.owner-secret-put@1). Each request carries the owner as actor and the service audits every change with that actor and key, never the value.

key.description: The setting key, as platform.owner-settings@1 names it.

value.description: The new typed value. A nano_usd value is an integer string; a float is never a value.

reason.description: Why the owner changed it; recorded in the service's audit line.

type.description: The owner; a service or an app is never the actor.
